**Describe the bug**

If you're in app details under parameters tab, the page resets or takes you to the top. This behavior is present in read or edit mode. UI users are unable to make changes because of these resets. I think this bug is present when you have lots of values, more than…

reproduce, deploy an helm app with lots of helm values. To go app details, select parameters tab. Scroll down or select the edit button. At some point, the UI will reset, taking the user to the top or exit edit mode.

**Expected behavior**

Expected behavior is that the UI should not scroll to the top or exit edit mode when scrolling under Parameters tab.

PR (cited in the notes as #21625): fix(ui): prevent parameter editor from resetting when props update (fixes #14351) [closed; labels ready-for-review]
Fixes #14351

**Explanation**
The UI is continually making calls to `appdetails` and `syncwindows` when viewing an Application or its settings.

When this happens it updates the input passed to the `<DataLoader />` inside the `application-parameters` component, which causes it to re-run its `load` function. Without setting `noLoaderOnInputChange` to `true`, this causes the component to render `loading...` momentarily every time the input prop ch…

function completes.

Because the component has an "edit" mode, this can be problematic as the switch to "loading..." and back causes the component to reset to its base state, losing the change the user might be in the middle of making. I believe this is what is being described in the referenced issue, and our users have the same problem.
